en-US.title: Tipwise: Tip & Split
en-US.subtitle: Split the bill to the cent
en-US.promoText: The calm, beautiful way to tip and split. No ads, no tracking, no account — just the right number, fast.
en-US.description:
Tipwise is the tip calculator you'll actually enjoy using.

Type the bill on a big, satisfying keypad and Tipwise instantly shows what everyone pays — tip, total and each person's share, down to the last cent.

SPLIT IT FAIRLY
• Split between any number of people.
• When a bill doesn't divide evenly, Tipwise tells you exactly who pays the extra cent — so the total always adds up.
• Round up with one tap so everyone pays a clean number. Tipwise shows the real tip percentage that results.

TIP YOUR WAY
• One-tap quick tips: 15, 18, 20, 22 and 25% — or set your own.
• Swipe the tip ruler to any percentage, with a crisp haptic click at every step.
• Tip before tax: enter the receipt total and Tipwise removes the sales tax before calculating the tip.

MADE FOR EVERYWHERE
• Automatically uses your local currency, or pick from 27 currencies.
• Handles currencies without cents, like the Japanese yen.
• Gorgeous in light and dark mode.

THOUGHTFUL DETAILS
• Share the breakdown with friends in one tap.
• Remembers your tip, party size and preferences.
• VoiceOver labels on every control.
• Works offline.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. No account. Tipwise never collects any data — your numbers never leave your phone.
